text: Slack huddles keep dropping audio during calls. It is very frustrating.
Love the new interface! Very clean and fast.
Notifications are delayed on my phone by at least 10 minutes.
Search function is okay, but it could definitely be faster when looking up old files.
Integrations with Jira and GitHub are seamless. Great job to the team.
The app crashes every time I try to upload a large video file.
Can we get more custom emoji slots? We are running out of space for our team.
Honestly the best team communication tool out there. Never goes down.
Dark mode is too hard to read in daylight. Needs better contrast.
Screen sharing on huddles is incredibly laggy today.
I just use it for basic chatting and it works fine. Nothing special.
The threads feature is brilliant for keeping conversations organized.
CPU usage spikes to 100% when I have multiple workspaces open. Please fix.
Why did you change the navigation bar? It takes more clicks to find my DMs now.
Voice notes are a lifesaver when I am walking. Excellent audio quality.
Standard messaging app. Does what it needs to do.
The new canvas feature is amazing for collaborative meeting notes!
Missing notifications randomly. I missed an important meeting because of this.
iPad version feels like a stretched phone app. Needs better tablet optimization.
Search filters are incredibly powerful. Found a message from 3 years ago instantly.
It disconnected me three times today while I was typing a long message.
File downloading gets stuck at 99% constantly.
The UI update grew on me. I actually prefer the new sidebar now.
It works okay but uses way too much RAM for a chat application.
Love the custom status automation through the API.
